sources.title: GitHub - 169Pi/Alpie-Core: Alpie Core: 4-bit Quantized Reasoning Model ...
sources.snippet: We introduce Alpie-Core, our first-generation reasoning model. It is a 32B-parameter system built on the DeepSeek-32B family and fine-tuned in 4-bit precision. By using quantization techniques like QLoRA, combined with parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA, and leveraging synthetic dataset distillation, Alpie-Core achieves high efficiency in reasoning, mathematics, and coding ...
